name: Orama MCP (repo knowledge search)
description: Installs an MCP server that indexes Markdown, JSONL, and PDF files in the workspace with Orama (in-memory hybrid BM25 + vector search) and exposes them to MCP clients such as Claude Code. Runs by default as one shared streamable-HTTP service per container, so every client session reuses a single index and embedding model.

version.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or commit) of quebi-gmbh/mcp-features to build packages/orama-mcp from. 'latest' resolves to 'main'.

transport.description: How MCP clients reach the server. 'http' (default) runs ONE shared streamable-HTTP service per container, started by postStartCommand -- every client session reuses a single index, embedding model, and file watcher. 'stdio' registers the binary for the client to spawn per session instead (one full copy of the index per session).

port.description: Port for the shared HTTP MCP service (transport: http). Ignored for transport: stdio.

globs.description: Comma-separated globs of files to index.

ocr.description: Enable OCR fallback for scanned/image-only PDFs (pages with no text layer). Installs tesseract.js and passes --ocr to the server. Born-digital PDFs never need this.

autoRegister.description: Merge an entry into the workspace .mcp.json so MCP clients auto-discover the server. Set false if claude-manager (or another tool) owns .mcp.json.
